test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book 'Defending India'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaswant Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Defending India attempts to comprehensively analyze the management of conflicts and security challenges faced by India during its first half-century as a free country
 
• This book plumbs the sources of Indian strategic culture and thought, the evolution of its armed forces, and the management of conflicts in the past 50 years.​
